subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Generic runtime object layer in the 0x0055A060..0x0055D900 band: scene-file parsing (View / light / Instance elements consumed from a shared line/token stream), display-mode and render-device wrapper objects (DirectX display-mode query, video-manager teardown forwarding, vertex color fill), a vtable-backed render-property object driven through a sub-device at this+0x1100, and construction/cleanup primitives for a display-mode node (field pair 0x104/0x108, partial zero-init range 0x10C..0x120, linked list head at 0x120).

summary: Proposed reconstruction of generic runtime objects in the 0x0055A060..0x0055D900 band. The strongest clusters are: (a) a scene-file parser family sharing a line/token stream (LineReaderFromBuffer 0x00559A70, token query 0x00559E20, float/color readers 0x00559FB0/0x00559F00), with ParseViewElement (DERIVED owner SceneViewParser) plus two GUESS-members (ParseLightSceneProperties, SceneInstanceLinkParser); (b) a vtable-backed render-property object (RenderStateObject) whose six methods (0x0055C070, 0x0055C860, 0x0055C9B0, 0x0055CA40, 0x0055CC20, 0x0055CF50) all drive a sub-device reached through this+0x1100 and share flags at 0x13C4/0x13CC/0x14F0/0x1550; (c) a display-mode node whose construction/cleanup pair (0x0055BB50/0x0055BB70) touches the 0x104..0x120 region and whose list head lives at 0x120, with the string-plus-fields reader 0x0055BE20 reading the same 0x110/0x114 fields; (d) a DirectX display-device wrapper (0x0055C330) querying a device pointer at this+0x10FC via vtable+0x20; (e) a vertex-color fill node (0x0055D900) with source stride 48 / destination stride 64 and a color dword at +24. Six functions remain owner UnknownObject (0x0055BBF0, 0x0055BFC0, 0x0055C040, 0x0055C060, 0x0055D2F0, 0x0055D590). Contradictions preserved: the RenderStateObject vtable slots are only identifiable by dispatch offset (the sub-device class is unnamed); DisplayModeNode's ownership is inferred from overlapping field ranges on the same base 'this'; ParseLightSceneProperties and SceneInstanceLinkParser carry UNKNOWN packet owners and are grouped only by shared token-stream callees. All claims are DERIVED/GUESS; no function in the packet carried a CONFIRMED or FACT owner.

function_roles.role: Parse a 'View' element from a scene-file token stream: read view/recursion, color, clipplanes, orient, dir, size, center, clear, bgmap and separatesurfac attributes; configure a view object (angles in radians, projection, clip planes, packed color, orientation matrix or negated-direction translation) and tail-insert it into the owning scene list; return 0 on success, -1 on parse/allocation failure.

Scene-file light parser: read Type, View, Dir, Color, Range, Intensity and Active tokens from a line buffer; map Type to a light kind code (Directional=1, StaticOmni=4, MovingOmni=2); create a scene node via sub_545430; apply directional or omnidirectional setters; publish color/intensity to UI property slots and toggle the active flag. Return 0 on success, -1 on node-creation failure.

Parse one Instance block from a scene-file line buffer: allocate and initialize a 264-byte node, store the owning scene pointer at node+0x0, read Type/Instance/Light/Link/Adjacent tokens, select a storage flag (64 storage / 128 instance), copy the instance name, append the node to the scene master list and return 0.

Zero-initialize a display-mode node struct (GlobalZeroInit_c2a0) then write the same caller value a2 into fields at offsets 0x104 and 0x108; return the struct pointer. Invoked by sub_55BE80 during node construction.

Partial zero-initializer: zero a dword at offset 0, a byte at offset 4, and six dwords at 0x10C..0x120; leave the intervening range untouched; return 0. Called by sub_55BE80 as part of a larger construction sequence.
Free a singly-linked list whose head is stored at this+0x120 (per-node next pointer at node+0x20), freeing each node via FreeWrapper_7bcf, then null the head; no-op when the head is null. Return 0.
Thin forwarding wrapper: invoke sub_53DB90 with (dword_8B78A0, this, 0) and return that callee's result. Invoked by sub_55BE80.

String-plus-fields reader: when a2 is non-null copy the NUL-terminated string at this+4 into a2; when a3 is non-null write this+0x110 to *a3; when a4 is non-null write this+0x114 to *a4; return a4. Invoked by sub_55F0D0 on a display/audio config accessor path.
Trivial getter returning the dword at this+0x4; no guards, no calls, no global reads.
cdecl wrapper forwarding dword_8B78A0 and dword_8B8F0C to RendererResourceCleanup (0x0053EAD0) and returning its result; invoked by VidMan_Exit as part of renderer teardown.

Forwarding wrapper: compute the element this[*this + 2] (runtime-derived index), forward (dword_8B78A0, element, dword_8B8F28) to sub_555E50 and return its result; a2 is unused. Called from StateFlagComputation and VidMan_Enter as a call-through point.

Bind render resource properties from descriptor a2: when the a2+36 flag bit 2 is clear create a vertex/index buffer via the render-device vtable +144 slot and store it in *this; when the a3 flag bit 0x10 is clear configure render properties (multi-field setter, sub_554790(256), +200 status), sync the resource reference at 0x13CC, walk the descriptor resource list allocating locked buffers and uploading via +340/+284; mark the descriptor processed. Return the last status.

Query the current display mode from the DirectX device at this+0x10FC via vtable+0x20; store the result code at this+0x0; on failure log the error string and return -1; on success copy two mode fields to optional a2/a3 and, when a4 is provided, set the display mode via sub_55C450 (format 22 special-cased to 21). Invoked by VidMan_Enter.

Allocate a 64-byte buffer via BufferLockAllocate(this, this+0x1140, 64, 0, 2), copy caller-supplied data, drive vtable property updates (slots 0x88/0xC8/0x118), conditionally set the 0x13C4 init flag to 1, apply via PropertyValueSetterWithRefreshOnChange, and call vtable slot 0x8C when the ready flag at 0x1550 is zero.

Trivial getter returning the ready flag dword at this+0x1550; used by seven callers (ConditionalInit, ConditionalStateReset, sub_53EB70, sub_544740, sub_554F80, sub_5550E0, sub_560FE0) across the object lifecycle.

Action-enum dispatch through a virtual call: map a2 (1->256, 2->2, 4->3) to a render-device vtable +0x94 call with (this[0x1100], param, a3) and store the result at this[0]; any other a2 returns (a2-4) without a vtable call.

Apply camera/projection configuration read from source struct a2: preliminary sub_55CA90(this, *(a2+412), 0); pack a six-dword config array (a2+84/88/100/104 plus constants 0 and 1.0) into render-device vtable +0xA0; set mode flag 0x13A4 to 3 or 2 by the a2+128 bit and call vtable +0xC8(22, mode); clear bit 2 of 0x1174; when enable flag 0x13D4 is set chain buffer queries (vtable +0x98 ids 256/3/2), thunk processing (0x0050CBB0/0x0050CDF9), and apply via vtable +0x13C.

Iterative UI property update driven by control struct a3: one-time init through the render-device sub-object (slots +148/+200) guarded by flags 0x13CC/0x14F0/0x13C4; rebuild the flag word 0x1170 (init 256, OR 0x800/0x400/1 from source flag bits); iterate source rows (cap 0x13B0) dispatching per-row params via the multi-field setter and applying via slots +340/+284; release via slot +200(28,0) when 0x14F0 is set. Single caller sub_558E70.

Set or clear bit 7 (0x80) of the flag word at this+0x0 from boolean a2, then call DirectXVertexBufferTextureCoordinateSetup(dword_8B78A0, this, this+0x4, 1); return that call's result. Invoked by sub_4FCEE0 and ParseLightSceneProperties.

Getter reading three consecutive dword fields at this+0x44, this+0x48 and this+0x4C into the corresponding non-null output pointers a2/a3/a4; return a4. Invoked by sub_560C10 and sub_560FE0, consistent with a vector-component accessor.

Two-path vertex color fill: when bit 0x20 at byte (this+0x4)+156 is set, copy the color dword at +24 per vertex from the source array (this+0xC, stride 48) into the destination array (this+0x20, stride 64); otherwise compute RGBA via D3D-device vtable slots +24/+20 (globals dword_8B8F24/0x8B8F28), scale alpha by 255.0, pack via MMX against qword_8B6C20 and write the single packed color to every destination vertex.

classes.name: SceneViewParser
classes.responsibility: Parses a 'View' element from a scene-file token stream and constructs a view object (angles, projection, clip planes, packed color, orientation matrix or direction translation) tail-inserted into the owning scene list. Owner DERIVED from the packet's only named owner.

classes.name: SceneFileParser
classes.responsibility: Scene-file line parser family sharing a line/token stream (LineReaderFromBuffer 0x00559A70, token query 0x00559E20, float/color readers 0x00559FB0/0x00559F00). Member 0x0055A500 parses light blocks into scene nodes; member 0x0055A790 parses Instance blocks into 264-byte nodes appended to the scene master list. Both carry UNKNOWN packet owners and are grouped by the shared token-stream callees only.

classes.name: DisplayModeNode
classes.responsibility: Display-mode node construction/cleanup object: zero-init via GlobalZeroInit_c2a0 then a same-value pair at 0x104/0x108 (0x0055BB50), a partial zero-init of 0/4 and 0x10C..0x120 (0x0055BB70), a singly-linked-list teardown with head at 0x120 and per-node next at +0x20 (0x0055BBA0), and a string-plus-fields reader reading this+4, 0x110 and 0x114 (0x0055BE20). Ownership inferred from the overlapping 0x104..0x120 field range on the same base 'this' and the shared construction caller sub_55BE80.

classes.name: RenderStateObject
classes.responsibility: Vtable-backed render-property object: binds render resources from descriptors (0x0055C070), allocates update buffers and drives property updates (0x0055C860), dispatches action enums through the sub-device (0x0055CA40), applies camera/projection configuration (0x0055CC20), runs iterative per-row UI property updates (0x0055CF50) and exposes the ready flag at 0x1550 (0x0055C9B0). All six methods reach a sub-device through this+0x1100 and share state flags at 0x13A4/0x13B0/0x13B8/0x13C4/0x13CC/0x13D4/0x14F0/0x1550.

classes.name: RenderDeviceSubObject
classes.responsibility: Vtable-backed render device reached at RenderStateObject offset 0x1100; its first dword is a vtable pointer. Dispatch slots 0x90 (create vertex/index buffer), 0x94 (dispatch), 0x98 (query buffer), 0xA0 (set config), 0xC8 (set property), 0x11C (upload), 0x13C (apply), 0x154 (apply resource) sit on the object; slots 0x88/0x8C/0xC8/0x118 sit on its vtable table (base *(*(this+0x1100)+0x0)). No callee identities are resolved; slots are recorded by dispatch offset only.

classes.name: DisplayDevice
classes.responsibility: DirectX display-device wrapper: queries the current display mode from a DirectX device pointer at this+0x10FC via its vtable slot +0x20, stores the result code at this+0x0, and optionally sets the display mode through sub_55C450 (format 22 special-cased to 21). Invoked by VidMan_Enter.

classes.name: VertexFillNode
classes.responsibility: Vertex color fill node: a render-state pointer at +0x4 (flag byte at +0x4+156, offset 0xA0), vertex count at +0x8, source vertex array at +0xC (stride 48), destination vertex array at +0x20 (stride 64), color dword at vertex +24. Computed path uses D3D-device globals dword_8B8F24/0x8B8F28 and MMX packing against qword_8B6C20.

transitions.trigger: resource reference 0x13CC non-zero: clear it and issue the one-time render-device slot 0x94 call with (256, this+0x503)
init flag 0x13C4 != 1: set it to 1 and issue render-device slot 0xC8 call with (136, 1)
config source bit at a2+128 selects mode flag 0x13A4 = 3 (set) or 2 (clear), applied via slot 0xC8 with (22, mode) when the mode differs
enable flag 0x14F0 non-zero: issue slot 0xC8 call with (28, 0) to release the property group

interfaces.name: ISceneTokenStream
interfaces.purpose: Line-oriented scene-file token stream consumed by the scene parser family. LineReaderFromBuffer (0x00559A70) advances one line and returns a status code (1 = end, 2 = skip, 3 = EOF); token query 0x00559E20 matches an attribute name against the token and copies its value string; 0x00559FB0 reads one float quartet/pair seeded from a token-specific default; 0x00559F00 reads a packed color triple. Attribute name strings live in the 0x005DC2xx global block.

interfaces.name: IRenderDevice
interfaces.purpose: Vtable-backed render device reachable at RenderStateObject offset 0x1100 (first dword = vtable pointer). Call sites exercise object slots 0x88/0x8C (handle/reset), 0x90 (create vertex/index buffer), 0x94 (dispatch), 0x98 (query buffer), 0xA0 (set config), 0xC8 (set property), 0x118 (set parameter), 0x11C (upload), 0x13C (apply) and 0x154 (apply resource). Slots are identified only by dispatch offset; no callee identity is resolved in this packet.

compatibility_contracts.name: SceneFileTokenStreamProtocol
compatibility_contracts.description: The scene-file parser family consumes a line-oriented token stream: LineReaderFromBuffer (0x00559A70) returns status codes 1 (end), 2 (skip) and 3 (EOF) stored at the stream head; token query 0x00559E20 matches attribute-name strings against the stream; 0x00559FB0/0x00559F00 read float and packed-color attribute values seeded from per-token globals. A replacement parser must preserve the status-code semantics and the token-name globals (view, bgmap, separatesurfac, Type, Instance, Light, Link, Adjacent, Directional, StaticOmni, MovingOmni, Active, Range, Intensity, Color, Dir, clear, orient, size, center).

compatibility_contracts.name: RenderDeviceDispatchSlotOffsets
compatibility_contracts.description: RenderStateObject carries a vtable-backed render device at this+0x1100 whose first dword is a vtable pointer. Call sites require object slots at offsets 0x90, 0x94, 0x98, 0xA0, 0xC8, 0x11C, 0x13C and 0x154, plus vtable-table slots at 0x88, 0x8C, 0xC8 and 0x118 (base *(*(this+0x1100)+0x0)). A replacement render device must keep these dispatch offsets and the caller-visible argument shapes (buffer creation, property set with (id, value), upload element counts).

compatibility_contracts.name: DisplayModeQueryContract
compatibility_contracts.description: DirectX display-mode query: the device pointer lives at this+0x10FC and its vtable slot +0x20 returns a mode struct (two fields) plus a result code stored at this+0x0. A non-zero result triggers an error log of the string at global 0x005DBCAC and return -1. Setting the mode goes through sub_55C450 with the read format, substituting format 21 when the read format equals 22.

compatibility_contracts.name: VertexFillLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: Vertex color fill: the source vertex array (this+0xC) has stride 48 and the destination vertex array (this+0x20) stride 64, both holding the color dword at vertex +24; the vertex count is at this+0x8. The computed path scales alpha at (this+0x4)+80 by 255.0 (constant 0x0059FEC8), queries D3D-device globals dword_8B8F24/0x8B8F28 and MMX-packs RGBA against qword_8B6C20.

compatibility_contracts.name: DisplayModeNodeLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: The display-mode node struct is zero-initialized (GlobalZeroInit_c2a0) before a same-value pair is written to 0x104/0x108; a partial zero-init clears offsets 0, 4 and 0x10C..0x120; a string is stored at this+4 and read back with fields 0x110/0x114; a singly-linked list of nodes (per-node next at +0x20) is anchored at this+0x120 and freed by walking and nulling the head.

compatibility_contracts.name: RenderStateFlagSemantics
compatibility_contracts.description: RenderStateObject state flags: 0x13C4 is a one-time init flag (set to 1 alongside render-device call (136, 1)); 0x14F0 is an enable/release flag (gates call (28, 1) on entry and (28, 0) on exit); 0x1550 is a ready flag read by seven callers and gating vtable slots 0x88/0x8C; 0x13CC is a resource reference synced against descriptor state and logged on change.

unresolved: ParseViewElement (0x0055A060): packet globals dbl_59E420, flt_59E450 and flt_59E65C are not referenced by the raw body; the source uses the literals 0.01745433 and 1.0 instead.

ParseViewElement (0x0055A060): the view object field layout is not exposed (the bgmap surface is allocated at +104 words on the parsed object, but no field: evidence ref exists for it); the nested-view recursion (self call) and the exact scene-list insertion semantics of LinkedListInsertTail vs DoublyLinkedListTailInsertion are caller-supplied.

ParseLightSceneProperties (0x0055A500): token-name strings (aType, aDir, aColor, aRange, aIntensity, aActive, aTrue, aFalse, directional/staticomni/movingomni) come from the DERIVED analysis layer; token-type codes 2/3 at *v3 are inferred; sub_545430 return semantics and a2 (scene context) role are unestablished; which member the UI property setters and BitFlagSetterWithDXUpdate address (light object vs scene UI context) is unproven; the View/off_5DC230 set appears redundant with SetUIPropertyGroupWithChainUpdate.

SceneInstanceLinkParser (0x0055A790): status-code semantics of LineReaderFromBuffer, the exact structure of the 264-byte node, the meaning of storage flags 64/128, and the behaviors of sub_5491D0 and sub_548E20 are unknown.
DualFieldSetToSameValue (0x0055BB50): why both fields at 0x104/0x108 hold the same caller value is caller-dependent (sub_55BE80 stores an entry index); owner type unknown.
PartialStructZeroInit (0x0055BB70): the object type and layout meaning of the zeroed fields are unknown; the returned 0 is likely ignored.
LinkedListFreeWithTraversalAndNulling (0x0055BBA0): field this+0x140 is flagged as read in the facts but not referenced in the body; node layout beyond the next pointer at +0x20 is unknown.

DisplayModeEnumeratorWrapper (0x0055BBF0): semantics of sub_53DB90 and its three arguments unknown; dword_8B78A0 is read as a plain integer global (object pointer vs handle unproven); why the caller needs the wrapper is unclear.

StringAndTwoFieldReader (0x0055BE20): semantics of the dword fields 0x110/0x114 unknown; the concrete type of this (display mode vs audio config) is unproven; the a2 destination buffer size contract is unknown (unbounded copy).
ReadDwordField4 (0x0055BFC0): object type and meaning of this+0x4 unknown; caller set spans unrelated subsystems.
GlobalDispatch (0x0055C040): role/type of globals dword_8B78A0 and dword_8B8F0C; RendererResourceCleanup return semantics unproven.

CallWrapper_c060 (0x0055C060): identity of sub_555E50 is absent from the packet; meaning of dword_8B78A0/dword_8B8F28; the this[*this+2] object layout is a runtime-derived index; parameter a2 is unused.

RenderResourcePropertyBinder (0x0055C070): the render-device vtable slot interfaces are unresolved beyond dispatch offsets; the descriptor a2 layout (flag byte at +36, source pointer at +12, resource-list header at +24) is inferred; the v11/v15 index arithmetic (16-dword entry stride, v15-2 vs v15/3 counts) is only partially evident.

DirectXDisplayModeGetCurrent (0x0055C330): v8 is read but never assigned (likely a decompiler artifact of the mode format field); the vtable+0x20 identity as GetDisplayMode and the roles of v7[0]/v7[1] as width/height come from analysis prose; the format-22-to-21 rule is not independently proven; owner type unknown.

BufferAllocateUpdateProperties (0x0055C860): meaning of vtable slots 0x88/0x8C/0xC8/0x118; the 64-byte buffer slot layout is unverified; the two near-identical this+0x1550 checks may be a duplicated decompiler artifact.
StructFieldGetter (0x0055C9B0): semantic meaning of the ready flag at this+0x1550 is unknown; no initializer/writer evidence in the packet.

mapEnumToVTableCall (0x0055CA40): the semantic meaning of a2 values (1/2/4) and mapped parameters (256/2/3) is unknown without the vtable contract; this[0] role as status storage is inferred from the write only.

ConfigUpdateFromSourceStruct (0x0055CC20): vtable entries identified by call-site offset only; meaning of the three thunk calls (0x0050CBB0 x2, 0x0050CDF9) and the buffer ids (256, 3, 2) not established.

IterativePropertyUpdateWithFlags (0x0055CF50): the vtable-backed sub-object behind this+0x1100 is unnamed; a3 control-struct flag bits are caller-defined; destination rows at &this[17*v11 + 1118] (17-dword stride) are a UI element array whose element type is not visible.
BitFlagSetterWithDXUpdate (0x0055D2F0): purpose of bit 7 and of the field at this+0x4; role of global dword_8B78A0 inferred from call order only.
TripleFieldGetter_d590 (0x0055D590): whether the three fields are floats or integers is not provable from this packet; the counterpart store sub_55D460 is asserted only by existing analysis.

VertexColorPackWithMMX (0x0055D900): fields this+0x54 and this+0xA0 are listed by static extraction but not accessed in the body; the two indirect D3D vtable calls (+24/+20) through dword_8B8F24 have no resolved callee; the direct-copy path meaning when bit 0x20 is set is not proven.
